description: Manifest 权威解析 - 明确各层 Authority 边界

manifestAuthority.role: Extension Package 声明层 (what extension provides/requires)

lifecycleAuthority.owner: Extension Kernel Lifecycle Saga (package_install_saga, package_update_saga, package_rollback_uninstall_saga)
lifecycleAuthority.metaDeclaration: Manifest.LifecycleMeta 只声明偏好 (AutoUpdate/Isolation/Sandbox)，不执行逻辑

contributionAuthority.role: Contribution 注册中心 (15 Contribution Kinds 分发到各自 Registry)

capabilityAuthority.role: Capability ID 生成与语义定义唯一事实源
capabilityAuthority.manifestRole: Extension 通过 ContributionMeta 引用 Capability ID，不定义新 ID

permissionAuthority.role: Permission 语义定义与运行时授权决策
permissionAuthority.manifestRole: Extension 通过 PermissionReq 声明引用，Manifest 不定义新全局 Permission ID

runtimeAuthority.role: 运行时绑定与实际执行
runtimeAuthority.manifestRole: Extension 通过 RuntimeMeta/RuntimeBindingMeta 声明期望运行时，实际调度由 RuntimeHost 负责

stateAuthority.owner: Domain-specific State Stores (enablement.StateStore, WorkflowRun, TaskRunStatus, etc.)
stateAuthority.manifestRole: Manifest 只有 valid/invalid 解析结果，不是运行状态事实源
